fg-front.prompt: Edit image 1, a registered flat silhouette guide, into final black-furred anatomical forearm artwork. Image 2 is ONLY a Japanese manga ink/fur style reference. CRITICAL silhouette lock: KEEP the exact uninterrupted straight taper/capsule silhouette, exact canvas size1024x1536, position, angle and scale of image1. The shape is ONE straight forearm segment from elbow to wrist, NOT an entire bent arm. Its single smooth outer contour must have NO separate muscle balls, NO second elbow nub, NO bicep lumps, NO indentation between lobes, NO bend within the segment, NO bean-stack, NO joint seam or transverse internal dividing crease. Add the same black ink and sparse warm ivory short hatch marks as reference fur, with minimal soft shading. It should read as smoothly tapering powerful anatomy, not a swollen sausage. Both rounded ends are concealed overlap for animation. Preserve shape and transparent empty canvas exactly. Do not copy any shoulder, torso, glove, cuff, hand, face or clothing from image2. Draw no guides or text, no extra fragments. Genuine clear transparency right up to a sharp ink boundary: NO glow, NO drop shadow, NO light/gray halo or fuzzy fringe. Output one connected clean forearm in place, not a full character or sheet. Target layer: FG front forearm.
